description:
Fast and Reliable Company Searches, Company Details, Funding Rounds, Investors, People, Acquisitions, and More from Crunchbase in Real-Time.

Operations (set "operation" to one of these; put its parameters in "args"):
- company_search (no required params): Company Search
- company_details (required: company_id): Company Details
- person_search (no required params): Person Search
- person_details (required: person_id): Person Details
- funding_round_search (no required params): Funding Round Search
- funding_round_details (required: funding_round_id): Funding Round Details
- investor_search (no required params): Investor Search
- acquisition_search (no required params): Acquisition Search
- event_search (no required params): Event Search
- hub_search (no required params): Hub Search
- category_search (no required params): Category Search
- location_search (required: query): Location Search
- autocomplete (required: query): Autocomplete

args.description: Parameters for the chosen operation as key/value pairs (see the tool description for required params).

operation.description: Which endpoint to call. See the tool description for each operation and its parameters.

name: realtime_crunchbase_data
